subject: Re: Clarityline customer spotlight — artwork & logo licensing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clarityline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarityline customer spotlight — artwork & logo licensing

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Clarityline's work on adaptive routing is exactly the kind of story we'd love to feature in a short customer spotlight on our site and a one-pager for our sales team.

Quick ask to move forward: would Clarityline be willing to provide written permission for Redwood to use the company name, logo, and up to two illustrative screenshots in the piece? We'd also like to pull a 1-2 sentence quote from you (or Tom) about the impact on latency and cost.

Attached are the assets we usually request and a first draft of the short copy so you can see the context:
- draft-spotlight-copy-v1.docx (draft)
- clarityline_brand_guidelines.pdf (for logo placement)

If this looks OK, Marissa (cc'd) can coordinate the art and final layout. If legal needs to review, happy to loop them. Would you prefer a short review window (48 hours) or a formal signature route?

Thanks — excited to showcase Clarityline.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: clarityline_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf)

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clarityline.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clarityline.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700

Hi Ben —

Thanks — we’d love to participate. A few quick clarifying Qs from our side before I confirm:
1) Which logo versions will you use (full-color vs. monochrome)?
2) Will the screenshots include any customer data or personally identifiable information?
3) Who is the final signatory for the permission? I’m looping Tom (legal) so we can get the right review.

We’ll take a look at the draft and Marissa, can you confirm expected publish date so we can align internal comms?

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Product & Partnerships
Clarityline
ellen.park@clarityline.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@clarityline.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clarityline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarityline customer spotlight — artwork & logo licensing

Hi Ellen / Tom —

Answers inline:
1) We prefer the full-color horizontal logo for web and a monochrome reversed variant for light backgrounds in one-pager PDFs. If you provide the logo pack we can follow your brand guidelines exactly.
2) Screenshots: we will use synthetic or redacted screenshots that show UI flow only — no real customer names or emails. We'll mark any sensitive screen with a redaction overlay and run that by you pre-publish.
3) Final signatory: either Tom or your designated legal rep is fine for the permission. If you prefer DocuSign, we can initiate.

Marissa — target publish window is the week of June 14th; can you confirm if that’s feasible? If yes, I'll ask design to prepare 2 layout options for review.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clarityline.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@clarityline.ai>
Cc: Clarityline Legal <legal@clarityline.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarityline customer spotlight — artwork & logo licensing

Hi all —

Legal here — thanks for the context. Attached are two small redlines to clarify scope:
- we need a clause that forbids use of our logo in any paid advertising without separate approval,
- we ask that any quotes attributed to Clarityline be approved by the signatory prior to publication.

I attached the redlines (CL_redlines_spotlight.pdf). I'm fine signing a short permission letter once we agree final wording. Prefer DocuSign for the signature step.

DocuSign (proposed): https://www.docusign.com/signing/CL-2027-spotlight

Tom Alvarez
Senior Counsel, Clarityline
tom.alvarez@clarityline.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarityline customer spotlight — artwork & logo licensing

Tom/Ellen —

Thanks for the redlines. I reviewed CL_redlines_spotlight.pdf and propose the following brief amendment that keeps your restrictions but reduces friction for marketing:
• Logo use: Redwood may use the provided logo assets on our website, one-pager PDFs, and social posts announcing the spotlight. Any use in paid ads requires prior written approval from Clarityline (email is acceptable).
• Quotes: Redwood will send any proposed quote attribution to the signatory for approval at least 48 hours prior to publish.

If that matches your intent I can prepare a one-paragraph permission letter and initiate DocuSign. We will only use redacted screenshots as Ben described; Marissa will send final images for one quick check.

If acceptable, please reply with an OK and the name of the person who will sign.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Legal (interim) | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Laura / Ben —

OK to the language Laura proposed. Tom will be the signer. We reviewed the draft and assets — logo pack and brand guidelines attached. We'll approve the final quote within 48 hours of review. Please send the DocuSign and we'll complete the signature.

Thanks!
Ellen
